Author: Matuno
Name: Party Scout
Description: Find Party Finder groups that match your goals, see their members and progress, and spot friends. Get alerts or opt in to automatic party switching.
Punchline: Find the right party and see who's playing.
Changelog: View party members beside Party Finder, keep your party's duty and description, and enjoy faster player lookups and finder visibility controls.

Author: Matuno
Name: Glamour Browser
Description:
Browse equipment by slot, move through model groups with Up/Down and compare variants with Left/Right. Save favourites, preview dyes and restore remembered pieces displaced by sets. Open with /glamourbrowse.

Visual trait classification and ring-side restoration are not included. The logo is AI-generated.
Punchline: Browse model groups, compare variants and preview gear with dyes.
Changelog: Initial Glamour Browser release: grouped model and variant browsing, favourites, dyes, remembered slot selections and Fitting Room controls.

Author: Detle
Name: Story Lens
Description: Tracks Free Company story clues using world observations and paced public Lodestone profile checks, with saved last-seen points and quest-chain previews.
Punchline: Quest markers and estimated Free Company MSQ progress.
Changelog: Quest objective markers, Free Company story estimates, player quest paths and saved last-seen evidence. Includes the 1.0.1 performance, reliability and localization fixes.
